messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a side-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to a side-view dolly-in shot that moves from full-body to upper-body framing. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, then raises one arm to touch the back of his head and shifts his weight while turning slightly.","camera":"A static medium-long shot from behind the character at roughly waist-to-head height.","clothing":"A tan plaid two-piece suit with a jacket and matching trousers, plus dark shoes.","hair_color":"Unclear, as the head is fully covered by a white cap.","hairstyle":"Hair is covered by a white cloth cap or turban tied at the back.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, shown from behind with his face not visible.","scene":"An old European-style street with cobblestones and storefronts bearing signs such as 'SOAP' and 'COCOA POWDER'."},"uncertain":["hair_color","face features","exact location or city"]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output begins with a wider full-body rear view of the character and gradually moves closer, ending in a tighter upper-body framing. The character's action, clothing, white cap, and street scene remain consistent with the source. The camera remains largely from behind rather than a clear side view.
arguments.requested_change: Switch to a side-view dolly-in camera shot starting from full-body framing and moving to upper-body framing, while preserving the character's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and action timing.
uncertain: Whether the final framing is sufficiently upper-body
Whether the camera angle qualifies as a side view rather than a rear view
unexpected_changes: The character's lower body is more visible at the start than in the source's initial close framing, consistent with the requested full-body start but changing the initial framing
